sentences.en: He claims that has no ax to grind with him.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己与对方没有私仇。

sentences.en: Sami had a few enemies with an ax to grind.
sentences.zh: 萨米有几个心怀不满的人。

sentences.en: "What an idyllic picture," he said with a wry grin.
sentences.zh: "多美的画面啊，" 他说着带着一丝苦涩的微笑。

senses.zh: 露齿而笑，咧着嘴笑；龇牙咧嘴
